notes.title: Bloopy & Droopy 1 year anniversary!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Today it's already been a year since Bloopy & Droopy was released, our very first game on this platform, time goes by so fast!

Happy Birthday Bloopy & Droopy!

To celebrate it properly, we are releasing the patch 1.2! But what's new in this version?

 We have entirely redesigned the graphics of the game to give you a better experience and for those who have already finished the game maybe the desire to try it again! A big thanks to Keenan_Dev for his amazing work!
 We have also arranged some of the text.


We sincerely hope that you will have a good time on Bloopy & Droopy thanks to these changes, especially in the graphics area, Have fun!

- DreamVeloper Studio.

notes.title: Bloopy & Droopy Version 1.1!
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are very happy to announce the release of the Version 1.1 of Bloopy & Droopy! What's new in this patch? Let's dig into this, right now!


 Some adjustements on certains levels, more particulary in Pluf Pluf River and Blocky City
 Your max lives increase from 5 to 10
 Captain Kurgos battle is now easier: less HP, attack speed of small ships have been lowered, more indications in phase 2 and less asteroids too. You also recover all your hearts between each phase now.
 Some minor bugs fixed
 We added a bunch of new languages: French, Spanish and Portuguese!


We sincerely hope you'll have a great time on Bloopy & Droopy thanks to these modifications, have fun!

- DreamVeloper Studio.
